metadata.name: doom
metadata.description: () - open a DOOM window: a wasm app (canvas) running Doom, lazy-fetching doom.wasm + the WAD from plastron.ca. Arrow keys / Ctrl (fire) / Space (use) drive the player when the window is focused. =doom()

metadata.name: doom.arm
metadata.description: (state) - fired when the DOOM window materialises; RAF-defers doom.boot so the canvas is mounted before the engine grabs it.

metadata.name: doom.boot
metadata.description: (state) - the browser boot: consent-gate the asset load, fetch doom.wasm + WAD, createDoomHarness, hydrate the kind:wasm engine cel, start the RAF tick loop.

metadata.name: doom.stop
metadata.description: (state) - stop the engine (cancel the RAF loop + dispose the harness).
